articles.title: Granddaughter of 1965 war hero, son of Army veteran: Meet R-Day parade contingent commanders
articles.summary: Lt Amit Choudhary, a second-generation army officer, is set to lead a contingent of mixed scouts in the upcoming Republic Day Parade on Kartavya Path. This significant role marks a personal milestone for Lt Choudhary, reflecting his family's military legacy. His participation embodies the spirit of national service and tradition, inspiring future defence aspirants.

articles.title: Pentagon foresees 'more limited' role in deterring North Korea
articles.summary: The Pentagon's new policy document indicates a "more limited" US role in deterring North Korea, shifting primary responsibility to South Korea. This strategic change redefines regional security dynamics, empowering South Korea to take the lead in its own defence against North Korean threats and potentially altering future US military presence on the peninsula.

articles.title: President Xi Jinping Speaks with Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva on the Phone
articles.summary: On January 23, 2026, Chinese President Xi Jinping engaged in a discussion with Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula. This high-level diplomatic interaction, confirmed by China's Ministry of Foreign Affairs, highlights ongoing bilateral relations between these influential nations. Such dialogues are crucial for fostering trade, investment, and geopolitical cooperation, indicating a continued commitment to strengthening their strategic partnership.

articles.title: Commentary by Aide to the President Yury Ushakov regarding Vladimir Putin's meeting with US President's Special Envoy Steve Witkoff
articles.summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin recently held a significant meeting with US President's Special Envoy Steve Witkoff. The diplomatic engagement also included Jared Kushner and Josh Gruenbaum. This high-level interaction between Moscow and Washington underscores ongoing communication efforts between the two global powers, likely addressing key international and bilateral issues amidst complex geopolitical landscapes.

articles.title: Top Chinese military officials face corruption probe
articles.summary: China has announced an investigation into its Central Military Commission's (CMC) senior vice chairman and another high-ranking military official. They are suspected of "serious violations of discipline," indicating a significant anti-corruption drive or internal power struggle within China's top defence leadership. This development highlights potential instability and ongoing efforts to assert control within the People's Liberation Army.

articles.title: Minister of Defence Antti Häkkänen: A new NATO accelerator site in Finland will combine technology, defence and economic growth
articles.summary: Finland, a recent NATO member, inaugurated a new NATO accelerator site in Espoo on January 22, 2026. Championed by Finland's Minister of Defence, this initiative strengthens NATO's innovation ecosystem, focusing on developing cutting-edge defence technologies and capabilities. It signifies Finland's commitment to collective security and technological advancement within the alliance, boosting strategic research and development.
